olivia-sec: Proposal — reduce dev SIEM retention from 60d -> 14d to lower monthly bill.
tom-ops: okay but we need a safe way to capture evidence when dev traces are needed for vuln triage.
priya-sre: idea: preserve prod logs 365d in SIEM; nightly encrypted snapshot of prod to an evidence-bucket. dev stays 14d, but we allow targeted captures via an opt-in tag `evidence_hold`.
ash-infra: IAM/RBAC change required. Propose roles: `log:export:request`, `log:export:approve`, `log:export:retrieve`. Only groups security:forensics and legal:ediscovery get approve/retrieve.
sara-legal: legal needs a Jira ticket attached with `case_id`, justification, requestor, approver, and a `legal_hold` flag. Audit metadata must be retained for 8 years.
priya-sre: integrity: every export must include a manifest + SHA256 HMAC and the manifest stored as sibling object. Example manifest:
```
export_id: exp-2026-11-05-77
timestamp: 2026-11-05T09:12:00Z
origin: prod-eu
case_id: CASE-2026-777
retention_days: 365
legal_hold: false
hmac: sha256:abcdef... 
```
olivia-sec: KMS Q: will rotating CMKs make old exports unreadable?
ash-infra: not if we retain previous key versions and grant decrypt to the export service principal. We should add a documented rewrap process to re-encrypt an object under a new CMK if customers request it.
tom-ops: gate exports via Jira + OPA: rule sketch — auto-approve when `incident_id` present and requester in security group; otherwise require manual `log:export:approve` from security lead. Deny retention_days > 730 without exec security signoff.
sara-legal: confirm default `legal_hold=false`. If legal_hold=true, export cannot be auto-deleted until hold cleared and must keep full audit trail.
priya-sre: sample upload command we'll standardize and require server-side encryption:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/exp.tgz s3://evidence-bucket/2026-11-05/exp-77.tgz --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:99990000-aaaa-11aa-2222-bbbbbccccc
```
olivia-sec: add a validation job that runs nightly: checks each export has a manifest, HMAC verifies, and Jira ticket metadata present.
ash-infra: will draft IAM PR with role definitions and CMK key policy. Also will add a key-rotation runbook with rewrap commands.
tom-ops: I'll author the OPA rego + Jira automation (auto-comment and attach approver) and include a deny policy for over-retention.
sara-legal: legal signoff pending that Jira justification is mandatory and audit trail stored off the bucket (separate audit-store) for 8 years.
deploy-bot: reminder — infra deploy window 2026-11-10 01:00-03:00 UTC.
olivia-sec: action list: (1) infra IAM PR + CMK policy (ash), (2) OPA + Jira workflow (tom), (3) export template + manifest validator (priya), (4) legal metadata + archive retention (sara). I'll draft RFC and link back here. :thumbsup:
